name: Lattice Shard
lore: A splinter of the dome-lattice that never fully set after The Dome Stabilisation. It hums against the palm. The Curators pay well and ask few questions about where it was found.

name: Refusal Iron
lore: Forged in the Refusal Keep and quenched in oaths. It does not bend, which is the entire point. The Watch's Founder's Edge blades are drawn from it.

name: Sundered Glass
lore: Sand fused to glass in an instant at The Sundered Verge when the lattice tore. Beautiful, unstable, and prone to backfire in a careless craft — a high-potency input only a steady bender should risk.

name: Linkway Filament
lore: A single drawn strand of Concord Link conduit, salvaged where the frontier cabling frayed. Hold it to your ear and you can just make out the route-hum of somewhere you have never been.

name: Tunyan Pearl
lore: Grown slow in tunya's deep beds, where the divers hold their breath longer than any surface-dweller believes possible. It is always warm to the touch, as though it kept a little of the depths' pressure inside.

name: Hushvein Silver
lore: Ore that drinks sound. A blade sheathed near it makes no whisper; a room panelled in it keeps its secrets. The Watch mirrors their signals off hushvein leaf so no listener two streets over can read the flash.

name: Dome Condensate
lore: Dew that beads along the dome lattice in the grey hour before the world's first tick. Collected drop by drop, it holds a faint charge of the stabilisation that keeps the sky from tearing again.

name: Sere Ledger-Wax
lore: Seal-wax scraped from sere's contract vaults, where every promise is pressed and filed. It is said the wax remembers the shape of what it sealed — press it twice and the second impression argues with the first.

name: Black March Tar
lore: A cold seep welling up through the floor of the sovereign-ruins. It burns without heat and leaves a rime of frost where it catches. The scavengers who work the black march learn to move quickly and touch nothing twice.

name: Founder's Quench
lore: The residue scraped once a year from the bottom of the Refusal Keep's oath-quenching bath, where the Founder's Edge blades were first cooled. A single measure will set a temper no ordinary forge can undo.

name: First-Dawn Amber
lore: Resin the Curators swear predates the first tick of the heartbeat — a bead of the world before it began to keep time. Whether that is true or merely the oldest story anyone still tells, it resolves hotter than anything else a bender can hold.
